title: Demo: issue anatomy showcase (fixture)
description: A fixture for eyeballing the issues layout with every section populated — multi-tier notes and brainstorm (including a 5-level nesting demo that hits the loader's hard cap), plans with stages, agent-memory split into knowledge and history, and THREE agent logs chosen to be realistic rather than exhaustive: a loop that ran six rounds and carries a child agent log with its own status, an audit whose pair is two files plus the merged verdict, and an experiment that was deliberately abandoned. Deliberately not a catalogue of every kind and shape — a fixture full of one- and two-file stubs teaches the wrong thing. Not real work.
author: sidhantha

ex.name: experiment
ex.desc: One-off exploratory spikes — keep or discard.
